outcome: immediate breastfeeding success (presence of breastfeeding, need for formula supplementation, average number of breastfeeding sessions, time per breastfeeding session, newborn stools and wet diapers produced daily, neonatal percentage in weight loss)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 1,904 nulliparous women who had term, singleton, vaginal deliveries at a large academic institution between 2017 and 2018.
finding: Women who experienced PPH after vaginal delivery had significantly fewer breastfeeding sessions, spent more time at each session, and their neonates experienced a greater percentage of weight loss over the first 2 to 3 days of life compared to those without PPH.
